terms.title: Terms & Conditions & Regulatory Consent
terms.subtitle: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (DLG) 2022 & Account Aggregator Data Processing Agreement
terms.section1Desc: AltGrade collects alternate financial data including bank statement transaction patterns (via Finvu AA), telecom bill regularity, location stability indicators, and self-reported psychometric questionnaires to evaluate credit risk for credit-invisible individuals and MSMEs.
terms.section2Desc: By proceeding, you grant explicit, time-bound consent to retrieve and analyze your consented data streams. No data is shared with unauthorized third parties. All data is processed strictly for alternate credit score estimation.
terms.section3Desc: Under RBI DLG rules, you retain full ownership of your data and may revoke consent or request data purge at any time through the AltGrade consent dashboard or by emailing support@altgrade.in.
terms.section4Desc: AltGrade uses Isotonic Calibration and SHAP feature explainability. You have the right to receive a human-readable explanation of key factors influencing your risk band and participate in AI conflict resolution.
terms.agreeCheckbox: I have read, understood, and agree to the Terms & Conditions and RBI Regulatory Consent.
